evidence.conclusion: The script bundled in Batch023 does not generate the bundled exact registries from the authorized historical CSVs. It is a reconstructed audit replay, not the original generator.
evidence.github_history_search: Candidate commits preserve rules and summary metrics but no original registry-generation program was found.

invalidated_claims: The Batch023 ZIP script is the original generator.
Running the Batch023 ZIP script establishes exact raw replay parity.
The nine exact registries are currently reproducible from the preserved repository code.
preserved_facts: Registry SHA and row-count parity passes for the supplied exact CSV bodies.
Derivative filters reproduce from their supplied parent/support registries.
Raw CSV time remains bar-open time in MT5 server time.
No candidate is live-ready or registered.
required_before_raw_parity_claim: Recover the actual original generation script or execution notebook/environment.
Recover the exact raw data snapshot used to create the registries, with hashes.
Or perform a new independently versioned reconstruction and do not call it original parity.
